decision: Close the route-diagonal bypass without variants. It moves held-out mean RMSE just below the quality gate but recovers only 0.0001303 of train residual energy and remains 0.0154312 below the required capture. Authorize one read-only analytic derivation of the minimum PCA dimension that reaches the unchanged 0.98 residual-energy criterion, followed by a single validation oracle at that derived dimension; this is a threshold measurement, not a rank sweep.
claim_boundary: Negative read-only route-diagonal capacity evidence only; no realizable model, checkpoint, autonomous quality, physical runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
